# FreimSite

> The official site template for Freim Deploy — a production-grade Astro 7 starter:
> SEO done properly, islands (zero JavaScript by default), twenty content collections
> validated with Zod, and a click-to-edit CMS contract out of the box. A repository
> becomes a live site through Freim Deploy, and a client then edits their own content
> through the CMS portal by clicking on the live page — no admin backend, no code editor.

> **Naming note:** the deploy config file in this repository is called
> `frostdeploy.json`, not `freimsite.json`. That is deliberate, not a mistake: Freim
> Deploy — the platform this template deploys to — used to be called FrostDeploy, and
> servers already running that platform in the field read this exact filename to find
> their own updates. The name never changes. Never write `freimsite.json` or
> `freim-deploy.json`; the file is and stays `frostdeploy.json`.

Get started (as a working directory, not a server):

```
git clone https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite.git my-site
cd my-site
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, what the template gives you, the CMS chain, deploy, license
- [README.ru.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/README.ru.md): the same in Russian
- [docs/en/quick-start.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/en/quick-start.md): install, run, the command reference, what the demo site ships with
- [docs/en/structure.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/en/structure.md): the directory map, and why most of the site ships zero JavaScript (islands)
- [docs/en/content.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/en/content.md): content collections, the Zod schemas behind them, adding your own
- [docs/en/cms.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/en/cms.md): the `content.schema.json` / `data-cms` / `fd-edit.js` contract that lets a client edit content through the portal
- [docs/en/deploy.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/en/deploy.md): `frostdeploy.json` field by field, and why its name never changes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository rules for coding agents working in this template — component-first workflow, ownership map, the two rules that must never be relaxed (the manifest filename, never naming a client)
- [docs/recipes/README.md](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimSite/blob/main/docs/recipes/README.md): twenty-three field-tested recipes (lead pipelines, product feeds, scroll-driven animation, and more) — Russian, code-first
- [Freim Deploy](https://github.com/ARTFROST1/FreimDeploy): the deploy platform this template is built for

## Notes

- Stack: Astro 7, React 19 (islands only), Tailwind v4, TypeScript strict, Zod schemas
  as the single source of truth for content.
- Ten longer reference documents and the recipe library under `docs/` are written in
  Russian — they double as the maintainer's own working notes. An AI agent reads them
  fine regardless of the working language; the five pages under `docs/en/` are the
  English entrance hall.
- License: MIT. Use it, fork it, ship it in commercial client work.
- This repository is both a public template and the maintainer's personal working
  copy: a guard test (`scripts/__tests__/public-tree.test.ts`, run by `npm test`) fails
  the build if a client's name, a macOS home-directory path, or a personal email
  reaches a tracked file.
